ns2:Work.dc:title: Misc - STEMTrafficLight
ns2:Work.dc:description:
Payas STEM Dene Yap: hollow tower, exactly two mounting tabs.
External dimensions. Leave bottom unglued for maintenance. Mechanically checked prototype only: battery/switch envelopes are unresolved in components.json. Burn is a per-side offset; calibrate on actual plywood.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes STEMTrafficLight --thickness=3.0 --burn=0.15 --labels=0 --reference=0 --tabs=0 --qr_code=0 --debug=0 --inner_corners=corner --sheet_width=1500 --sheet_height=3000 --format=svg Command line short: boxes STEMTrafficLight --burn=0.15
